verdict.rationale: Ramp ships 'Ramp Intelligence'/'Ramp agents' as a built-in AI layer across the product that autonomously codes expenses, drafts memos, flags fraud, and escalates or auto-approves within guardrails ('No money ever moves without a human confirmation'), which is a genuine in-product delegation model rather than just an external MCP connector. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the in-app assistant's reliability and a documented conversational chat UI (evidence mostly describes background automation rather than an explicit chat-based task delegation interface).
